item.title: ‘Come and take it’: Massachusetts governor challenges RFK Jr.’s request for Dunkin’, Starbucks ingredients

item.description: The California School Employees Association (CSEA) has recently filed three separate labor complaints against the Vallejo City Unified School District. item.title: Vallejo man charged in February slaying
item.description: Solano County Sheriff’s Office and the Solano County District Attorney’s Office announced the arrest and formal charges against a suspect in the Feb. 9 shooting death of a 29-year-old Vallejo man. Marquis Matthew Davis, 39, of Vallejo is charged with one count of murder in connection with the death of Damarrea Neal, 29, of Vallejo, and is held without bail in Solano County Jail.
